question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Know the ropes
solution:
The correct answer is:** To understand the details**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**know the ropes**" means to have a good understanding of a particular situation or task.
 
• It is often used in reference to a new job or role, where someone needs to learn the specifics in order to succeed.
